interface.signature: def smallestWindow(S: str, P: str) -> str:

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in S) and all(c.islower() for c in P)
preconditions.description: All characters in S and P are lowercase alphabets.
Both S and P are non-empty strings.

postconditions.expression: return_value == "-1" or (len(return_value) == len(P) and all(P.count(c) <= return_value.count(c) for c in set(P)))
postconditions.description: If no valid window exists, return "-1"; otherwise, return the smallest substring of S containing all characters of P (including duplicates).

postconditions.expression: all(c in P for c in return_value) if return_value != "-1" else True
postconditions.description: The returned substring (if not "-1") must contain all characters of P.

postconditions.expression: return_value == "-1" or (len(return_value) == min(len(window) for window in [S[i:j] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S)+1)] if all(P.count(c) <= window.count(c) for c in set(P))))
postconditions.description: The returned substring is the smallest possible window in S that contains all characters of P.

postconditions.expression: return_value == "-1" or (return_value == S[start:end] for start, end in [(i, j) for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S)+1)] if all(P.count(c) <= S[i:j].count(c) for c in set(P)) and len(S[i:j]) == len(return_value)) and all(S[i:j] < return_value for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S)+1) if all(P.count(c) <= S[i:j].count(c) for c in set(P)) and len(S[i:j]) == len(return_value) and S[i:j] < return_value))
postconditions.description: If multiple windows of the same minimal length exist, the one with the smallest starting index is returned.
